name: [2x Coins]Tower of Misery
desc:
⭐ UPDATE [MAY 8]: New winners room, more leaderboards, server king, overhead level displays, limited-time sales, & more! ⭐

This game is inspired by Tower of Hell and made by ToH fans.

Reach the top of the tower made of randomly generated stages before the clock runs out. Earn coins to purchase gears and server effects in the shop, and level up to climb your way up the leaderboard.

All content in game, including any sponsored content, was developed, uploaded and published by the game's development team.

Tags: Tower, Misery, Obby, Parkour, Climb, Fun, Mega Easy, Rainbow, Obstacle Course, Easy, Colorful
